response.sql: WITH linked AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS acl_igm FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID), deviations AS (SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, acl_igm - AVG(acl_igm) OVER () AS deviation FROM linked), sex_averages AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation FROM deviations GROUP BY SEX), ranked AS (SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.acl_igm, d.deviation, d.deviation - s.avg_deviation AS excess FROM deviations AS d JOIN sex_averages AS s ON d.SEX = s.SEX WHERE d.deviation > s.avg_deviation) SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm AS `aCL IgM`, deviation AS deviation_from_overall_mean, excess AS above_sex_average_deviation FROM ranked ORDER BY CASE WHEN excess IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, excess DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Each linked examination row is one entry in the overall and sex averages.
